title: 1 · 절제된 확대
prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / stylized-concept. Generate ONE new full-body FRONT0 DEGREE SD PIXEL-ART character concept on genuine clean alpha transparency. This is a new natural anatomy redraw, not a collage, pasted head, mathematical stretch or rescaled original.
Input1 = authoritative ORIGINAL warrior identity, hair design, outfit, weapons, palette and pixel finish. Input2 = small game-avatar body/design reference only; not a fixed head ratio. Input3 = small-character face/silhouette legibility principles only, never copy those characters. Input4 = hand grasp anatomy only, never copy its armor or sword.
MAIN CORRECTION: enlarge the ACTUAL SKULL UNDER THE HAIR and the VISIBLE FACE, not just hair volume or eyes. Keep the original spiky layered GOLDEN BLOND hairstyle and fringe rhythm, wrapping it naturally around the larger skull. No bald finished art. Do not make the hair fluffier or spikes taller as a substitute. Facial skin between temples/cheeks and brows-to-chin must occupy visibly more of the whole-character height than original. Preserve young adult MALE identity, BROWN eyes, composed youthful warrior expression; not a child/toddler/female.
At the same displayed whole-character height, the larger cranium/face must be unmistakable. Work in an underlying scalp-crown-to-chin unit, excluding protruding hair spikes. Do NOT reuse3.3 hair-inclusive-head units. The numeric aim below is a DESIGN EXPLORATION, not a user-approved standard.
INVARIANTS: blue scarf and short lowered hood, silver chest/shoulder/forearm armor and gauntlets, blue waist cloth, brown belts/pouch/trousers. Anatomical RIGHT (viewer LEFT) shoulder bears crescent. Anatomical RIGHT (viewer LEFT) leg has silver plated shin/boot, anatomical LEFT (viewer RIGHT) blue cloth wrapped boot with small metal protectors. Keep original armor motifs/palette and equipment shapes; no cape/helmet/new accessories.
Exactly TWO weapons: anatomical RIGHT HAND/viewerLEFT holds the LONGSWORD with BLUE DIAGONAL blade accents, wing-shaped silver guard and ring knuckle protector; LEFT HAND/viewerRIGHT holds SHORT ANGULAR DAGGER with small guard. Natural continuous forearm/wrist/palm, thumb opposing curled fingers around actual grip, one coherent straight handle/guard/blade axis. Longsword relaxed downward diagonal across front toward opposite foot; dagger lowered outside the opposite leg. Both sole contacts planted in front-view idle stance, no walking/attack.
Established crisp small pixel clusters and dark colored contour as original, broad silver cel facets, blue fabric and warm brown leather. No smooth3D, no glossy painted illustration, no text/watermark/red guide lines.
Square framing, similar hair-to-sole height for all four: aim hairTop at8% canvas height and soles94%; all hair/boots/sword tips fully inside with margin. Entire subject centered, front camera same height as original. Body, neck, shoulders, arms, hands and legs must be naturally redesigned around the new cranium/face proportions while keeping the complete recognizable warrior identity. No background/shadow/grid.
OPTION1: Restrained but clearly visible enlargement. A gently tapered young-man jaw with modest cheek breadth; preserve the familiar calm gentle brown eyes and a tiny near-neutral closed smile. Actual cranial dome and face should be clearly larger than the original when whole-character height is equal. Compact adult-youth chibi body, medium shoulder width; retain enough leg length for a composed warrior.
Exploratory anatomical proportion aim: true SCALP CROWN-to-CHIN about29% of hair-top-to-sole whole-character height; visible face skin width about24% of that whole height. Keep hair cap and spikes comparatively restrained so the increase belongs to skull/face. Make brows, cheeks, jaw, nose and mouth benefit from the enlarged face, not only eyes.
